mapper.select: SELECT office_code AS id, '0' AS parent_id, office_name AS title FROM system_dept WHERE extend_s4 IS NOT NULL AND zip_code IS NOT NULL AND status = '0'
SELECT id, #{officeId} AS parent_id, position_name AS title FROM fms_position_archive WHERE type = 'CJ' AND region = #{officeId} AND status = '0'
SELECT id, work_shop_id AS parent_id, prod_line_name AS title FROM fms_prod_line WHERE work_shop_id = #{workshopId}
SELECT id, prod_line_id AS parent_id, work_group_name AS title FROM fms_work_group WHERE prod_line_id = #{prodLineId}

SELECT sp.id, #{workGroupId} AS parent_id, sp.name AS title, sp.identity_card AS id_card, sp.id AS personId FROM swm_person sp LEFT JOIN fms_worker fw ON sp.identity_card COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = fw.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
(fw.work_group_id = #{workGroupId} OR sp.team = #{workGroupId}) AND sp.identity_card IS NOT NULL AND sp.status = '0' AND sp.personnel_status = '1'
AND sp.person_type IN
#{personType}
